This case-sensitive code system https://mitre.org/fhir/space-health/CodeSystem/space-adverse-event-cs defines the following codes:

extrapyramidal Extrapyramidal SymptomsDystonia, akathisia, or other movement disorders from antiemetic use

dry-mouth Dry Mouth (Xerostomia)Anticholinergic dry mouth from scopolamine or promethazine
blurred-vision Blurred VisionVisual disturbance from anticholinergic effects
